title: RetroGEF: Dynamic Graph Edit Flow for Single-Step Retrosynthesis
abstract: arXiv:2609.38484v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrosynthesis enables the discovery of viable synthetic routes to target molecules. It plays a central role in modern drug discovery and materials design. Retrosynthesis involves molecular graph transformations that can change both connectivity and graph size. These transformations may introduce reactant components absent from the target while revising the product-derived structure. To model these transformations, we propose RetroGEF, a flow-based generative model for single-step retrosynthesis. Starting from the target molecule, it constructs possible reactants by adding atoms and changing bonds in the molecular graph. RetroGEF models molecular transformations and changes in graph size within the same generative process, rather than relying on a fixed-size graph canvas. It learns this process directly from product--reactant pairs without requiring a prescribed edit order. Experiments on representative retrosynthesis benchmarks demonstr

translated_title: RetroGEF：用于单步逆合成的动态图编辑流
translated_abstract: 逆合成能够发现目标分子的可行合成路线，在现代药物发现和材料设计中发挥着核心作用。逆合成涉及分子图的变换，这些变换可以同时改变分子的连接性和图的规模。这些变换可能引入目标分子中不存在的反应物组分，同时修正来自产物的结构。为了对这些变换进行建模，我们提出了RetroGEF，一种用于单步逆合成的基于流的生成模型。从目标分子出发，它通过在分子图中添加原子和改变化学键来构建可能的反应物。RetroGEF在同一个生成过程中对分子变换和图规模的变化进行建模，而不是依赖于固定大小的图画布。它直接从产物-反应物对中学习这一过程，无需预先规定编辑顺序。在代表性逆合成基准上的实验表明……
tldr: RetroGEF提出了一种基于流的生成模型，通过在统一的生成过程中动态地添加原子和修改化学键来处理单步逆合成中分子变换与图规模变化，无需依赖固定大小的图画布或预定的编辑顺序。
en_tdlr: RetroGEF is a flow-based generative model for single-step retrosynthesis that models both molecular transformations and graph size changes within a single generative process by dynamically adding atoms and modifying bonds, without relying on a fixed-size graph canvas or a prescribed edit order.
